name: Mekgineer Thermaplugg
summary: In ruined Gnomeregan, Mekgineer Thermaplugg rules from a massive mechanical battle suit. Once High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque’s trusted advisor, he brought about the city’s irradiation in a bid for power. The fallout made him a leper gnome and left him deranged, ruling the ruined halls.

sections.title: A Toxic Ambition
sections.body: For many years, Mekgineer Thermaplugg advised High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, who trusted him completely. Yet Thermaplugg secretly coveted the High Tinker’s office. Even Mekkatorque cannot say what drove his advisor to betray that trust. He can only wonder whether Thermaplugg sought power or wealth, both of which he would have had in time.

sections.title: The Poisoning of Gnomeregan
sections.body: During the Third War, troggs swarmed Gnomeregan from below, and the gnomes fought them in the dark. Seeking a way to break the siege, Gelbin asked Thermaplugg for counsel. Thermaplugg urged him to flood the city with radioactive gas, claiming it would destroy the troggs and spare the gnomes. He meant instead to use the crisis to unseat Mekkatorque and seize power.

sections.title: King of the Ruins
sections.body:
Thermaplugg’s gamble went terribly wrong. Radioactive fallout swept through every level of Gnomeregan, killing eighty percent of its gnomes and twisting many survivors into feral, diseased leper gnomes. The radiation warped Thermaplugg too and drove him utterly mad.

Thermaplugg crowned himself King of the Gnomes and rules among irradiated machines and mutated thralls. His forces fight trogg invaders and surface gnomes seeking to reclaim their lost home.

aliases: who is the boss in gnomeregan
faq.answer: Before betraying his people during the trogg invasion, Mekgineer Thermaplugg was High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque’s chief advisor. He urged Mekkatorque to release radioactive gas into Gnomeregan so he could seize power. The gas nearly extinguished the gnomish population, and Thermaplugg now rules the irradiated ruins as a mad king.

faq.q: Why did Thermaplugg betray Gelbin Mekkatorque?
faq.answer: Even Mekkatorque cannot say for certain why Thermaplugg betrayed him. The High Tinker wonders if Thermaplugg sought power or wealth, both of which he would have had in time. Thermaplugg had long coveted the High Tinker’s office and used the trogg crisis to seize Gnomeregan for himself.

faq.q: Did Thermaplugg cause the trogg invasion?
faq.answer: Troggs first broke into Gnomeregan’s lower levels after they were unearthed from the ancient titan vault of Uldaman. Rumors say Thermaplugg knew of the breach or even helped bring it about to create a crisis. Mekkatorque has never verified whether Thermaplugg started the invasion or simply exploited it.

faq.q: What happened to Thermaplugg after the gas was released?
aliases: how did he become a leper gnome
faq.answer: Thermaplugg suffered lethal radiation along with thousands of other gnomes. The fallout withered his flesh, turned his skin sickly green, and fractured his mind. He stayed behind to rule the ruins as the self-proclaimed King of the Gnomes instead of fleeing with surviving refugees to Ironforge.
The Crowd Pummeler 9-60 is a hulking gnomish war machine that still stomps through Gnomeregan’s Engineering Labs. It is one of many mechanical guardians defending Thermaplugg’s irradiated domain.

faq.q: What does High Tinker Mekkatorque want done with Thermaplugg?
faq.answer: Mekkatorque regards Thermaplugg as his greatest failure and his people’s greatest traitor. From his temporary court in Ironforge’s Tinker Town, he commissions brave Alliance adventurers to enter Gnomeregan’s irradiated depths and execute Thermaplugg. He seeks justice for the fallen.

angles.text: Thermaplugg embodies what your people mourn and despise. His vanity and treachery cost you your homeland and turned your kin into diseased horrors.
Thermaplugg’s betrayal kept Gnomeregan from answering the call to arms in the Third War. It crippled Alliance supply lines and engineering support during humanity’s darkest hour.
Thermaplugg shows the lethal danger of sloppy formulas and unprincipled design. He wields hazardous walking war machines and toxic bomb Dispensers against anyone who enters his workshop.
Your kin in Ironforge gave refuge to survivors fleeing Thermaplugg’s poison. Ironforge guards watch the Dun Morogh gates closely against his irradiated wanderers.
